{{Short description|52nd season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 1982–83 National Hurling League |image = |dates = 17 October 1982 – 17 July 1983 |teams = |team1 = Kilkenny |titles = 6th |captain1 = |manager1 = |two = Limerick |three = Kildare |four = Cavan |previous = [[1981–82 National Hurling League|1981–82]] |next = [[1983–84 National Hurling League|1983–84]] }} The '''1982–83 National Hurling League''' was the 52nd season of the [[National Hurling League]]. ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |season=1982-83 |winners=[[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]]
5th National League title
Captain: [[Liam Fennelly]]
Manager: [[Pat Henderson (hurler)|Pat Henderson]] |relegated=[[Offaly GAA|Offaly]]
[[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] |continentalcup1= |continentalcup1 qualifiers= |continentalcup2= |continentalcup2 qualifiers= |league topscorer=[[File: Colours of Kilkenny.svg|border|20px]] [[Billy Fitzpatrick]] (4-33) |best goalkeeper= |biggest home win= |biggest away win= |highest scoring= |matches= 32 |total goals= |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest winless= |longest losses= |highest attendance= |lowest attendance= |attendance= |average attendance= |prevseason=[[1981-82 National Hurling League|1981-82]] |nextseason=[[1983-84 National Hurling League|1983-84]] |updated=5 March 2017 }} Division 1 saw a major restructuring with the abolition of the fourteen-team top flight which had previously been divided into two groups of seven teams. For the 1982-83 season, Division 1 was limited to a single group of eight teams. [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[1981-82 National Hurling League|1981-82 season]]. On 24 April 1983, Kilkenny won the title after a 2-14 to 2-12 win over [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] in the final. It was their 5th league title overall and their [[1981-82 National Hurling League|second in succession]].{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} Kilkenny's [[Billy Fitzpatrick]] was the Division 1 top scorer with 4-33. ===Table=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: centre;" !width=20|Pos !width=150|Team !width=20|Pld !width=20|W !width=20|D !width=20|L !width=20|Pts !width=250|Notes |- style="background:gold;" |'''1'''||align=left|''' [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] '''||'''7'''||'''5'''||'''1'''||'''1'''||'''11'''|| National League champions |- style |'''2'''||align=left|''' [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] '''||'''7'''||'''5'''||'''0'''||'''2'''||'''10''' |- |'''3'''||align=left|''' [[Clare GAA|Clare]] '''||'''7'''||'''5'''||'''0'''||'''2'''||'''10''' |- |'''4'''||align=left|''' [[Cork GAA|Cork]] '''||'''7'''||'''3'''||'''1'''||'''3'''||'''7''' |- |'''5'''||align=left|''' [[Galway GAA|Galway]] '''||'''7'''||'''3'''||'''0'''||'''4'''||'''6''' |- style |'''6'''||align=left|''' [[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] '''||'''7'''||'''2'''||'''1'''||'''4'''||'''5''' |- style="background:#fcc;" |'''7'''||align=left|''' [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] '''||'''7'''||'''2'''||'''0'''||'''5'''||'''4'''||Relegated to Division 2 |- style="background:#fcc;" |'''8'''||align=left|''' [[Offaly GAA|Offaly]] '''||'''7'''||'''1'''||'''1'''||'''5'''||'''3'''||Relegated to Division 2 |} ===Group stage results=== {{football box collapsible |date =17 October 1982 |team1 = [[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] |score = 2-11 -
